title: Divide and Collapse: MAPF-Collapse via Exact Decomposition into Independent Sub-Instances
abstract: arXiv:2609.39559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work we study the problem of MAPFC, a post-optimization step for Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) plans where we are given a feasible plan produced by a modern MAPF solver and are tasked with removing avoidable moves while preserving feasibility. This NP-hard problem naturally arises when using learning-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) solvers which construct plans that contain redundant moves that can be removed. Recently, Tang et al. presented Judgelight, which uses Integer Linear Programming (ILP) to solve MAPFC. Importantly, the ILP is constructed over all agents jointly, so its cost is governed by the full instance rather than by the small coupled residue that actually requires joint reasoning. Our key insight, motivating this work, is that MAPFC instances naturally decompose into independent sub-problems, most of which involve a single agent and can be solved without any inter-agent reasoning. translated_title: 分而坍缩：通过精确分解为独立子实例实现MAPF坍缩
translated_abstract: 本文研究MAPFC问题，这是多智能体路径规划（MAPF）方案的一种后优化步骤：给定一个由现代MAPF求解器生成的可行方案，任务是在保持可行性的前提下移除可避免的移动。这一NP难问题在使用基于学习的最先进（SOTA）求解器时自然出现，因为这些求解器构建的方案中包含可被移除的冗余移动。最近，Tang等人提出了Judgelight，该方法使用整数线性规划（ILP）来求解MAPFC。值得注意的是，该ILP是在所有智能体上联合构建的，因此其开销由完整实例决定，而非由实际需要联合推理的少量耦合残余部分决定。启发本工作的关键洞察是：MAPFC实例可自然分解为独立的子问题，其中大多数仅涉及单个智能体，无需任何智能体间推理即可求解。为此，我们首先识别……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是发现MAPFC实例可被精确分解为独立子实例，其中大多数仅涉及单个智能体、无需任何智能体间联合推理，从而将计算开销从完整实例规模降至仅需联合推理的少量耦合残余部分，显著优于对所有智能体联合建模的ILP方法Judgelight。
en_tdlr: The key contribution is an exact decomposition of MAPFC into independent sub-instances, most of which involve only a single agent and require no inter-agent reasoning, so joint computation is confined to a small coupled residue instead of the full instance, overcoming the cost of Judgelight's monolithic ILP over all agents.
